capability: circular-tube Graetz entrance-region Nusselt number Nu(x*) from the D2Q5 lattice advection-diffusion solver
disclosure: The n_r=40 coarse level and the defect hypothesis (half-cell wall geometry in graetz_lbm) were explored BEFORE this pre-registration. All fine-level (n_r=80) runs, the acceptance decision, and the reference used for the verdict are fixed below and were not tuned after seeing the fine-level numbers. Station list, thresholds and both geometric variants are identical for every level.

reference.kind: independent re-implementation of the Graetz/Shah-London series
reference.locked_inputs: published eigenvalues lambda_n = 2.70436, 6.67903, 10.67338, 14.67108, 18.66987, 22.66914, ... (Chandrasekhar 1961; Shah & London 1978); Nu_inf = lambda_1^2/2 = 3.6568
reference.independence: reference eigenfunctions (RK4) + Sturm-Liouville orthogonality coefficients + cup-mixing temperature are computed in the reference module; the library series and the library FV march are only used as cross-checks, never as the verdict reference

variants.orig: library graetz_lbm as merged: velocity profile radius R = n_r-1, wall Dirichlet half a cell outside
variants.reff: consistent geometry: R_eff = n_r-1/2 used in velocity profile, diameter, cup-mixing and Nu

gates.G1_accuracy: max |Nu_lbm/Nu_ref - 1| <= 3% over x* in [0.005, 0.04] at BOTH levels
gates.G3_frontier_report: x* = 0.002 is reported, not gated (thermal boundary layer ~2 cells there at n_r=40); a >3% value is disclosed, never masked
gates.G4_variant_verdict: the accepted geometric convention is the one that satisfies G1+G2; the other is reported as a defect with its numbers

acceptance_rule: A variant is VERIFIED only if G1 and G2 hold simultaneously; otherwise the case is reported FAIL for that variant.

amendment_1.reason: compute budget: the n_r=80 fine level (~520 s/node) could not be scheduled inside the mission window; the refinement pair is reduced to n_r in {40,56} (ratio 1.4). Reference, stations, thresholds and the verdict rule are unchanged; no n_r=80 number was ever produced or seen before this amendment.
